executive_summary.deployment_recommendation: Do not deploy to production until critical and high severity issues are resolved
key_strengths: Strong TypeScript usage with 837 type definitions
Comprehensive RLS policies on all user tables
Supabase Auth with JWT and email verification
No hardcoded secrets in source code
Clean git history with no committed secrets
Proper test infrastructure with 396 test files
critical_areas_requiring_attention: CORS configured to allow wildcard origins
Rate limiting middleware not applied to any routes
Open redirect vulnerability in auth callback

secrets_and_credentials.summary: 4 production credentials exposed in .env.local file including service_role key, NextAuth secret, and Supabase access token

issues.title: Supabase Service Role Key Exposed
issues.description: Service role key bypasses all Row Level Security policies
issues.recommendation: Rotate key immediately in Supabase dashboard, audit database logs, never commit this key

issues.title: NextAuth Secret Exposed
issues.description: Exposed secret allows session hijacking and token forgery
issues.recommendation: Generate new secret (openssl rand -base64 32), update production, invalidate sessions

issues.title: Supabase Access Token Exposed
issues.description: Personal access token grants management API access
issues.recommendation: Revoke token in Supabase dashboard, generate new token, review access logs

issues.title: Supabase Anon Key Exposed
issues.description: Production anon key committed to filesystem

dependency_vulnerabilities.summary: 1 moderate CVE in Vite, 31 outdated packages, 1 deprecated package

issues.title: CVE-2025-62522: Vite Server.fs.deny Bypass on Windows
issues.description: Files denied by server.fs.deny sent if URL ends with backslash on Windows

issues.title: pdfjs-dist 147 versions behind
issues.recommendation: Update to 5.4.296, test PDF parsing thoroughly

code_quality.summary: Good architecture with some large files, excessive console logging, and type safety gaps

issues.title: XSS Vulnerability in Export Utility
issues.description: innerHTML used without sanitization in print functionality
issues.recommendation: Sanitize HTML with DOMPurify or use DOM manipulation

issues.title: 673 Console Statements in Production Code
issues.description: Excessive console logging causes performance degradation and potential data leakage
issues.recommendation: Replace with structured logger from lib/utils/logger.ts

security_patterns.summary: Good authentication foundation but missing critical security headers and rate limiting

issues.title: CORS Wildcard Origin Allowed
issues.description: CORS allows all origins (*) if ALLOWED_ORIGINS not set
issues.recommendation: Set explicit ALLOWED_ORIGINS, never use wildcard in production

issues.title: Rate Limiting Not Applied
issues.description: Middleware exists but not used on any API routes
issues.cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts
issues.recommendation: Apply withAuth to all routes, use Redis for production

issues.title: Open Redirect Vulnerability
issues.description: Unvalidated redirect_to parameter in auth callback

issues.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
issues.description: No CSP header configured to prevent XSS attacks

issues.title: Missing HSTS Header
issues.description: No Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS
issues.cwe: CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

repository_integrity.summary: Well-maintained repository with documentation sprawl and uncommitted changes

issues.title: 417 Uncommitted Changes
issues.description: Large uncommitted changeset suggests incomplete work
issues.recommendation: Create atomic commits for logical groups

issues.title: Documentation Sprawl (22 root MD files)
issues.description: Fix documentation scattered at repository root
